# `csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks`

Preservation mode. Defaults to true when max_line_length is off.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `(derived from max_line_length)`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = true`

```ini
max_line_length = 80
csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build(string name)
    {
        var greeting = new StringBuilder()
            .Append("Hello, ")
            .Append(name);
        return string.Join(", ",
            greeting,
            "!");
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build(string name)
    {
        var greeting = new StringBuilder()
            .Append("Hello, ")
            .Append(name);
        return string.Join(", ",
            greeting,
            "!");
    }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = false`

```ini
max_line_length = 80
csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build(string name)
    {
        var greeting = new StringBuilder()
            .Append("Hello, ")
            .Append(name);
        return string.Join(", ",
            greeting,
            "!");
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build(string name)
    {
        var greeting = new StringBuilder().Append("Hello, ").Append(name);
        return string.Join(", ", greeting, "!");
    }
}
```
:::
